name: Ruvo
long_description:
Ruvo is a global dollar account built for individuals and businesses operating in Brazil and around the world. Whether you're a Brazilian freelancer, an international company, or a business with operations across borders, Ruvo makes it easy to manage money globally.

Get your own US account to receive payments from clients and employers worldwide, hold your balance in dollars, convert to reais and make Pix payments in minutes, or send USD through ACH, wire, RTP, and SWIFT. Spend globally with the Ruvo card.

Ruvo supports personal (CPF) and business (CNPJ) accounts, as well as eligible international entities, including US LLCs, BVI companies, and other entities.

With simple, transparent pricing, receive USD through ACH, wire, or RTP for free, convert dollars to reais via Pix for 0.9% for individuals or from 0.3% for businesses, with no IOF on eligible transactions. You can also earn up to 4.3% annually on eligible dollar balances.
one_liner: The Global Dollar App for Brazil
